prompt: My cousin who I used to be very close with when we were growing up has recently started making passive aggressive comments about my weight and appearance every time we see each other at family gatherings and it's making me dread going to any family events even though I used to love them

I lent my car to my brother last weekend because he said he needed it for an important errand but he returned it with a huge scratch on the side and when I confronted him about it he said it was already there which I know for a fact is not true

My manager keeps scheduling important meetings at times when they know I have standing commitments and when I've asked them to consider alternative times they just say that the schedule works for everyone else so I need to figure it out

My childhood best friend got engaged recently and didn't ask me to be in the wedding party even though I always assumed we would be in each other's weddings and now I'm questioning our entire friendship and whether I've been overestimating how close we are

My partner's mother makes little comments about how I keep the house and what I cook for dinner whenever she visits and my partner never stands up for me and tells me I'm being too sensitive about the whole thing

A colleague at work has been taking credit for ideas I've shared in brainstorming sessions and presenting them as their own in meetings with upper management and I've talked to them about it but they just deny doing anything wrong

My upstairs neighbor has a dog that barks constantly throughout the day and night and I've left polite notes and tried to talk to them about it but nothing has changed and I'm losing sleep and can't focus on my work

My best friend canceled our vacation plans that we'd been looking forward to for months because something better came up and they didn't even seem sorry about it just expected me to understand and not be upset

My father keeps making comments about when I'm going to settle down and have kids even though I've told him many times that I'm not sure that's what I want and he acts like my life choices are a personal disappointment to him

My roommate's significant other has basically moved in without contributing to rent or utilities and they're always in the common areas and eating our food and my roommate gets defensive whenever I try to bring up the issue
